<reason>PRO made the live choice easier to decide: CON would still bar removal under gold-standard process, would confine the person rather than briefly take the gun, and never closed the suicide-tool gap. CON was more complete, honest on the predicate line, and stronger on search-first costs, but the least-intrusive paradox and funeral-versus-calendar weighing carried the motion. B’s three clipped turns keep this competitive rather than dominant.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>PRO’s Q2 forced CON’s “yes, I would still oppose it,” then used that plus the 72-hour-hold leftover-gun problem to recast CON as seizing the body while leaving the cabinet untouched.</best_rebuttal>
